sql.if: AND (t.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR COALESCE(e.tenant_code, '') LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))

mapper.sql: t.id AS id, COALESCE(e.tenant_code, CONCAT('T', t.id)) AS code, t.name AS name, COALESCE(e.logo_hue, 0) AS logoHue, COALESCE(e.org_type, '') AS orgType, COALESCE(e.stages, '[]') AS stages, COALESCE(e.package_id, 0) AS packageId, COALESCE(e.biz_status, 2) AS status, t.end_date AS expireTime, e.trial_end_time AS trialEndTime, COALESCE(e.ai_used, 0) AS aiUsed, COALESCE(e.storage_used_gb, 0) AS storageUsedGb, t.create_time AS createdAt, COALESCE(e.contact, '') AS contact, COALESCE(e.phone, '') AS phone, COALESCE(e.city, '') AS city, COALESCE(e.address, '') AS address, COALESCE(e.intro, '') AS intro, COALESCE(e.cert_files, '[]') AS certFiles, CASE WHEN e.isolation_type = 'dedicated' THEN 2 ELSE 1 END AS isolationType, COALESCE(e.storage_region, '') AS storageRegion, e.disable_reason AS disableReason, COALESCE(e.switches, '{}') AS switches, COALESCE(e.quotas, '{}') AS quotas
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM sys_tenant t INNER JOIN edu_tenant_ext e ON e.org_tenant_id = t.id AND e.del_flag = 0 WHERE t.del_flag = 0

SELECT
FROM sys_tenant t INNER JOIN edu_tenant_ext e ON e.org_tenant_id = t.id AND e.del_flag = 0 WHERE t.del_flag = 0 AND t.id = #{id}
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM sys_user_tenant WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND status = '1'
